en_title: Valve Developer Mistakenly Mentions Rumored Half-Life 3 Codename
cn_title: Valve开发者意外提及《半衰期3》代号
subtitle: 失言引爆猜测
opus_summary: Valve音乐设计师Mike Morasky在GameSoundCon问答中意外提及HLX。这个多年来被认为是《半衰期3》代号的项目仍在开发，但是否就是《半衰期3》、何时公布或发售，目前都没有答案。

paragraphs.en: A Valve developer mistakenly slipped up and made mention of Half-Life 3's long-rumored codename during a recent conference.
paragraphs.cn: Valve一名开发者近日在会议上不慎失言，提到了《半衰期3》那个流传已久的代号。

paragraphs.en: For years, fans have wondered if we'll ever see Half-Life 3. During the 2010s, hope for the threequel was kept firmly alive by die-hard fans... but it was later revealed that the project had been quietly killed by Valve. However, hope was reignited when Valve released Half-Life: Alyx, which ended with a massive cliffhanger that seemed to directly set up Gordon Freeman's next adventure. Ever since then, there have been rumors of a third game, with various dataminers discovering references to a project known as "HLX" in various Valve-related files. It has been believed for years that HLX is indeed Half-Life 3, as no one has been able to link it to any other existing Valve project. (And, of course, the acronym all but screaming that it's Half-Life related.)
paragraphs.cn: 多年来，玩家一直想知道《半衰期3》是否终有一天会面世。2010年代，铁杆粉丝始终没有放弃对这部续作的期待……但后来有消息称，Valve已悄然取消了该项目。Valve推出《半衰期：爱莉克斯》后，粉丝们的希望再度燃起：游戏结尾留下了一个重磅悬念，似乎直接为戈登·弗里曼的下一段冒险埋下伏笔。此后，第三部作品的传闻不断，数据挖掘者也在多个与Valve有关的文件中发现了代号为「HLX」的项目线索。多年来，外界一直认为HLX就是《半衰期3》，因为没人能将它与Valve其他已知项目联系起来。（当然，这个缩写本身也几乎明示了它与《半衰期》有关。）

paragraphs.en: Now, Valve has acknowleged the project itself, though not on purpose. During a recent Q&A panel at GameSoundCon, a conference for video game audio, Valve's music designer, Mike Morasky, was explaining how the developer handled certain sound systems and noted that Deadlock uses a particular type of high dynamic range audio... and HLX uses its own kind of HDR.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，Valve意外提到了这个项目。在近期举行的游戏音频会议GameSoundCon问答环节中，Valve音乐设计师Mike Morasky谈到开发团队如何处理某些音效系统，并提及《Deadlock》使用了一种特定的高动态范围音频……而HLX则采用了自己的HDR类型。

paragraphs.en: We have the first mention of HLX by a Valve employee.
HLX files today. I'm working as quickly as I can. https://t.co/LhFBNOP1CU
paragraphs.cn: 「今天是HLX文件。我的进度已经尽可能快了。」https://t.co/LhFBNOP1CU

paragraphs.en: Once the words HLX came out of Morasky's mouth, he pretty much stopped talking. Whether that's because he had finished his thought or if he realized he should stop talking is up in the air. A colleague sitting next to Morasky then quietly said "nice work," which some fans have read into as a passive-agressive retort to Morasky's slip up. Fans went buckwild with this small, but notable mistake. Some ran with it, feeling like all of their theories and copium has been vindicated after this mention.
paragraphs.cn: Morasky说出HLX后，基本就不再发言了。他是刚好讲完了，还是意识到自己应该打住，目前不得而知。坐在他旁边的一位同事随后轻声说了句「干得漂亮」，一些粉丝认为这是在被动攻击Morasky的失言。这个小小却值得注意的口误让粉丝们彻底沸腾，有人借题发挥，觉得这次提及证明了他们此前的种种猜测和自我安慰并非空想。

paragraphs.en: Regardless, this does seem to confirm that HLX is a project that is still actively in development at Valve. We can only hope that it is the long-rumored Half-Life 3, but who knows how far away it could be from being announced, let alone released. Half-Life: Alyx had an exceptionally fast turn around time for being announced and released, so it's possible that a similar pattern would emerge here. If that's the case, maybe we can hope to see it at The Game Awards, but that's still probably a longshot.
paragraphs.cn: 无论如何，这似乎证实HLX仍在Valve积极开发中。我们只能希望它就是传闻已久的《半衰期3》，但没人知道它距离公布还有多远，更别说发售了。《半衰期：爱莉克斯》从公布到发售的间隔格外短，因此HLX也可能采取类似的节奏。如果真是如此，我们或许可以期待它亮相The Game Awards，但这恐怕仍不太可能。
